critical_code_review_comments: d7_engine.py / d10_engine.py: clean, deterministic, well-commented; uses Parashara classical rules (odd/even sign offsets 6 / 8). No floating-point edge issues observed.

server.py /api/charts/d1-d9: D1 returns planet `house` from stored kundli (computed at generation time), but ascendant rashi_idx is recomputed via int(asc_lon/30). For divisional charts D7/D9/D10 both are recomputed together, so ((rashi_idx - asc_idx)%12)+1 == house. For D1 a small off-by-one between stored house and recomputed asc binning is possible at sign boundaries — not a bug but worth a comment.
MultilingualEditorPage handleTranslateWholeItem has a sensible 1-retry on 'budget exceeded' with 1.5s back-off and 250ms pacing — good guardrails.
The 5-verse Hanuman Chalisa whole-item run completed all 5 verses with no failures during this test session — robust against the previously-reported intermittent 'Budget exceeded' 500.
